title: Translate frozen calls to provider transports
summary: GeminiByokAdapter translates a bounded text call to Gemini; SubscriptionBridgeAdapter calls an authenticated local bridge and verifies exact signed readback. Credential resolution stays inside these adapters.

replaceability.why: Provider transports handle credentials, real model spending and receipt evidence; creator layers cannot replace this foundation.
replaceability.decided: Self-Luc spec v0.3 (2026-10-18); charter rule 6; today's code: lumeri_runtime/model_broker_providers.py:259-285

operations.name: GeminiByokAdapter.execute

quote.description: Frozen PriceQuote with exact model, input bound, tariff and expiry; trusted Broker-owned Python value.

operations.notes: Draft: request and PriceQuote are documented semantically, not a full standalone provider request schema. No aggregate deadline; default transport enforces 30-second socket timeout. This adapter alone does not deduplicate Gemini calls; only Broker claim owns retries. Credential is resolved immediately before I/O and expiry is checked again.

operations.name: SubscriptionBridgeAdapter.request
operations.notes: Draft: full input semantics are Broker validation, not duplicated here. readback defaults false and uses a distinct readback route when true; it must not generate then. Default socket timeout is 30 seconds, not an aggregate deadline. Signature, nonce, path, timestamp, model, request hash, output cap and usage are verified. Proven bridge nonexecution may append a validated diagnostic to subscription_not_executed; dynamic suffixes are not exhaustively expressible by errors.

bounds.name: transport_socket_timeout_seconds
bounds.unit: seconds per default HTTP socket operation, not whole action

invariants.text: An ambiguous provider attempt is kept pending by the Broker and never regenerated by an execute retry.

break: the operation raises unexpectedly or returns an answer outside its declared schema
failure.notes: No replacement seam or run-time interface validator exists for this role today; the class describes who may eventually replace it.

conformance.notes: Existing tests are evidence for the named invariants, not a replacement conformance runner. Only the area contract checker is run in this task.

known_deviations.text: Subscription nonexecution codes may carry a validated suffix after subscription_not_executed; the format only admits a finite errors list.

open_questions.text: Add an explicit delegated/dynamic error-family field instead of either pretending a finite code list is exhaustive or listing unverified diagnostic suffixes.
